name: 2026-10-06-rental4-hw-gh200
status: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY PAGE: hardware constants measured independently of any fused_moe page, and consistency checks
design: owner decision 3 (RRZE-HPC/gpu-benches on the VM, GPL-3.0, fetched at a pinned commit, never vendored) and REANALYSIS.md section 4 (the rulers step)
tool: scripts/gpubench.py and scripts/hw_rulers.py on the VM; scorer scripts/scoring/rental4/score_hw.py

pin.note: third-party; fetched on the VM at this commit, never vendored into moe-kernels

rules.near_l2: median ns over buffers from 4 MiB to 0.4 L
rules.far_l2: median ns over 0.6 L to 0.95 L
rules.l2_plateau: median GB/s over total volume <= 0.25 L
rules.l2_half_way: the log-volume interpolation of the first fall below (plateau + floor) / 2
rules.stream: peaks per kernel; the least occupancy reaching 0.95 of the triad peak

gpubench.L: the card's L2 (60 MiB on GH200; the rulers' device query is printed beside it)

rulers.add: torch.add(a, b, out=c), fp32, each the buffer

checks.rule: each a CONSISTENT / DIFFERS line against the published GH200 value (SEEN third-party) within its band; latencies are compared in ns (the published run was at 1980 MHz, this one at the 1710 lock: an L2 or DRAM latency fixed in ns reads the same)

printed.eta_mix: bw 3598.0 GB/s (CAL, the 8x7B fit) over each streaming ruler (read2d, copy, add) and over triad
printed.tau_mma: matmul TFLOP/s over 132 SMs x 1.710 GHz: FLOP per clock per SM, an upper bound for mma.sync

use: the stamps F readout's rivals take this rental's latencies when gpubench ran and parsed
licence: gpu-benches' code never enters the repository; its printed outputs are measurements published with the session, attributed to RRZE-HPC (GPL-3.0 applies to the code, not to a measurement)

rrze_gh200.label: SEEN third-party (RRZE-HPC/gpu-benches master 23e586dd, GH200, 1980 MHz), parsed by gpubench.py's rules

seen_data: the comparison values are SEEN third-party (RRZE's published GH200 run)
